panel.title: HERDR machines
panel.description: Remote HERDR servers reached over SSH. Live terminals open in the official client.
panel.emptyHint: Add an SSH target to watch its agents here and open its sessions in the official client.
panel.sshAgentHint: Authentication uses ssh-agent and ~/.ssh/config. Key files saved in Yuzora are not passed on.
panel.windowsReconnectHint: Reconnect is not available on Windows. Load your key into ssh-agent, then check the status again.

interactiveAlreadyOpen: An interactive HERDR terminal is already open. Close it first.

unsupported.title: HERDR machines need HERDR 0.9.2 or newer
unsupported.description: The selected HERDR binary ({{version}}) is too old. Use the bundled HERDR 0.9.3 (recommended).
unsupported.probeFailed: Could not check HERDR machines support

remove.title: Remove {{label}}?
remove.description: This only removes the machine from your local HERDR list. The remote HERDR server and its sessions are not affected.

add.title: Add HERDR machine
add.description: Choosing the remote session and any install prompt happen in the terminal on the next step.
add.label: Name (optional)

interactive.clientHint: The official client cannot preselect a machine. Pick {{label}} in its machines sidebar.
interactive.hint: Finish SSH authentication and choices in this terminal. Esc or Ctrl+C cancels and nothing is saved.
interactive.unconfirmed: Could not confirm whether the machine was saved. Refresh the list.

legacy.description: Saved SSH hosts stay for Files, Git, databases, SFTP and Browser forwarding. For remote HERDR, use HERDR machines instead.

migrate.title: Convert {{name}} to a HERDR machine
migrate.description: The saved SSH host is kept as is. A HERDR machine is added next to it.
migrate.label: Name
migrate.keyWarning: This host uses a key file. The official HERDR does not accept key files: add the key to ssh-agent or configure it in ~/.ssh/config.

sidebar.openClient: Open in official client: select {{label}} in its sidebar

errors.machines-runtime-too-old: The HERDR binary is too old for machines. Use the bundled version (0.9.2 or newer).
errors.machines-invalid-target: Invalid SSH target. Use user@host or ssh://user@host:port without a password.
errors.machines-invalid-label: Invalid name. Use 1 to 128 characters without control characters.
errors.machines-unknown-machine: This machine no longer exists. Refresh the list.
errors.machines-disabled: This machine is disabled. Enable it first.
errors.machines-unsupported-subcommand: This HERDR version does not support that machine command.
errors.machines-auth-required: SSH authentication is required. Load your key into ssh-agent or reconnect.
errors.machines-host-key: SSH host key verification failed. Check ~/.ssh/known_hosts.
errors.machines-unreachable: The host is unreachable (connection refused, timed out or DNS failed).
errors.machines-remote-incompatible: The remote HERDR does not support machine API forwarding. Update it.
errors.machines-remote-server-stopped: The remote HERDR server is not running.
errors.machines-timeout: The machine did not answer in time.
errors.machines-output-too-large: The machine returned too much data.
errors.machines-parse-failed: The HERDR output could not be parsed.
errors.machines-reconnect-unsupported-windows: Reconnect is not supported on Windows. Use ssh-agent instead.
errors.native-client-limit: Too many official clients are open. Close one and try again.
errors.machines-local-only: This operation is only available on the local machine.
errors.machines-busy: Another operation on this machine is in progress.
